stones.title: 草酸钙肾结石
stones.blurb: 草酸钙是最常见的结石成分。标本馆用来对照外形，不是诊断某个人。
stones.blurbEn: Calcium oxalate is the most common stone composition. A specimen hall compares shapes. It does not diagnose a visitor.

stones.title: 尿酸输尿管结石
stones.blurb: 尿酸结晶在酸性尿里更容易析出。词条写化学，不写谁必须吃什么药。
stones.blurbEn: Uric acid crystals form more readily in acidic urine. Entries write chemistry, not a personal drug order.

stones.title: 磷酸铵镁鹿角石
stones.blurb: 感染相关的铸型可以长成鹿角状，填满肾盂。这是形态学，不是诊断。
stones.blurbEn: Infection-related casts can grow into a staghorn that fills a pelvis. Morphology, not a diagnosis.

stones.title: 胱氨酸结石
stones.blurb: 胱氨酸尿是一种罕见的转运问题，结石可以反复出现。百科写机制，不下结论。
stones.blurbEn: Cystinuria is a rare transport problem. Stones can recur. Encyclopedias write mechanisms, not verdicts.

stones.title: 磷酸钙钙化
stones.blurb: 磷酸钙和其他少见成分也会出现在标本盒里。成分化验才能对照，不是目测诊断。
stones.blurbEn: Calcium phosphate and other uncommon compositions also sit in specimen boxes. Lab assay compares them. Eyesight is not a diagnosis.

stones.title: 草酸钙砂粒
stones.blurb: 很小的砂粒有时会随尿排出。滤过尿液是常见的收集方法，不是治疗剂量。
stones.blurbEn: Very small grit sometimes passes with urine. Straining urine is a common collection method, not a treatment dose.

stones.title: 尿酸膀胱结石
stones.blurb: 膀胱里也可以形成结石。部位和成分是两套标签。这是解剖分类。
stones.blurbEn: Stones can also form in the bladder. Site and composition are two separate labels. This is anatomy class.

stones.title: 鸟粪石肾盂结石
stones.blurb: 磷酸铵镁常和感染菌一起被提起。词条写微生物与晶体，不写谁感染了。
stones.blurbEn: Struvite is often mentioned with urease-producing bacteria. Entries write microbes and crystals, not who is infected.

stones.title: 膀胱异物核心结石
stones.blurb: 历史上有结石围着异物生长的标本。这是博物馆故事，不是个人病史。
stones.blurbEn: Historical specimens show stones growing around a foreign core. Museum story, not a personal chart.

stones.title: 透镜状草酸钙
stones.blurb: 外形可以像透镜或桑葚。形状帮助对照成分，不能代替化验。
stones.blurbEn: Shapes can look lenticular or mulberry-like. Form helps comparison. It does not replace a lab assay.

stones.title: 碎石后的砂粒
stones.blurb: 体外冲击波之后，标本盒里常见碎屑。滤过尿液是为了收集，不是处方。
stones.blurbEn: After shock-wave treatment, trays often hold fragments. Straining urine collects them. It is not a prescription.

stones.title: 尿酸晶体块
stones.blurb: 尿酸石有时偏黄。酸碱和饮食词条会提到它，不写成禁令。
stones.blurbEn: Uric acid stones can look yellowish. Acid–base and diet entries mention them without writing a ban.

stones.title: 肾盏草酸钙
stones.blurb: 结石可以停在肾盏。部位标签是肾脏，不等于 spreading。这是空间描述。
stones.blurbEn: A stone can sit in a calyx. The site label is kidney. That is space, not a verdict that something is spreading.

stones.title: 多枚肾结石标本
stones.blurb: 一盒里可以有好几枚。数量用来教学，不用来推测某人身体里有几枚。
stones.blurbEn: A tray can hold several stones. Counts are for teaching, not for guessing how many sit inside a visitor.

stones.title: 输尿管路径上的尿酸石
stones.titleEn: Uric stone on the ureter path
stones.blurb: 结石进入输尿管时，词条常写绞痛。这是典型过程，不是说某人正在经历。
stones.blurbEn: When a stone enters a ureter, entries often describe colic. That is a typical course, not a claim that a visitor is in it.

stones.title: 经典草酸钙标本
stones.blurb: 教学用的结石照片强调表面和颜色。对照用，不下诊断。
stones.blurbEn: Teaching photos emphasize surface and color. They are for comparison, not diagnosis.
